Plot Deconstruction 

```{r}
# Load required packages for data wrangling and visualization
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(viridis)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Import and Wrangle Extracted Datasets
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Read the raw digitized files, rename the default PlotDigitizer 
# columns ('x' and ' y'), and add a Habitat identifier column.

inner_flat <- read_csv(here::here("data/plot_deconstruction/inner_flat.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(Year = x, Cover = y) %>%
  mutate(Habitat = "Inner Flat")

exposed_pools <- read_csv(here::here("data/plot_deconstruction/exposed_pools.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(Year = x, Cover = y) %>%
  mutate(Habitat = "Exposed Pools")

protected_crest <- read_csv(here::here("data/plot_deconstruction/protected_crest.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(Year = x, Cover = y) %>%
  mutate(Habitat = "Protected Crest")

exposed_crest <- read_csv(here::here("data/plot_deconstruction/exposed_crest.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(Year = x, Cover = y) %>%
  mutate(Habitat = "Exposed Crest")

# Combine all datasets into a single tidy dataframe for ggplot
coral_data <- bind_rows(inner_flat, exposed_pools, protected_crest, exposed_crest) %>%
  # Convert Habitat to a factor to strictly control the facet rendering order
  mutate(Habitat = factor(Habitat, levels = c("Inner Flat", "Exposed Pools", 
                                              "Protected Crest", "Exposed Crest")))

# Define historical cyclone events to map environmental disturbances
cyclone_years <- c(1967, 1971, 1978, 1980, 1990)

```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Part 4.2: Plot Reconstruction
# ---------------------------------------------------------
ggplot(coral_data, aes(x = Year, y = Cover, colour = Habitat)) +
  
  # FIX: Replace obscure x-axis arrows with clear vertical disturbance markers
  geom_vline(xintercept = cyclone_years, 
             linetype = "dashed", 
             colour = "darkred", 
             alpha = 0.4) +
  
  # Plot the continuous means
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  
  # FIX: Clean up redundant axes and floating text by using modern faceting
  facet_wrap(~ Habitat, ncol = 2) +
  
  # LAYOUT STANDARD: Apply an accessible, principled color palette 
  # guide = "none" removes the redundant legend to reduce clutter
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "plasma", guide = "none") +
  
  # LAYOUT STANDARD: Remove default grey backgrounds
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  
  # Fine-tune the professional styling
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 10, colour = "grey30", margin = margin(t = 15))
  ) +
  
  # LAYOUT STANDARD: Write a comprehensive, publication-grade figure caption
  labs(
    x = "Survey Year",
    y = "Coral Cover (%)",
    caption = "Figure 1. Multi-decadal trends in percentage coral cover across four shallow reef habitats.\nRed dashed vertical lines indicate years of major cyclonic disturbance (1967, 1971, 1978, 1980, 1990)\nknown to cause acute mechanical damage to coral assemblages. Original data digitized from Connell et al. (1997)."
  )
```

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)

# 1. Wrangle Data & Add Simulated SE
coral_data <- bind_rows(inner_flat, exposed_pools, protected_crest, exposed_crest) %>%
  mutate(
    Habitat = factor(Habitat, levels = c("Inner Flat", "Exposed Pools", 
                                         "Protected Crest", "Exposed Crest")),
    # Simulating Standard Error (SE) for the shaded ribbon effect
    SE = ifelse(Cover < 10, runif(n(), 1, 3), Cover * runif(n(), 0.1, 0.2)) 
  )

# Define disturbance years
cyclone_years <- c(1967, 1971, 1978, 1980, 1990)

# Create a small dataframe to control where the "Cyclone Event" text appears (top panels only)
anno_data <- data.frame(
  Habitat = factor(c("Inner Flat", "Exposed Pools"), levels = levels(coral_data$Habitat)),
  Year = 1964, 
  Cover = 98, 
  label = "Cyclone Event"
)

# Dataframe to bypass the annotate() facet bug for the year labels
cyclone_labels <- data.frame(
  Year = cyclone_years,
  Cover = -3,
  label = as.character(cyclone_years)
)

# 2. Build the Plot
ggplot(coral_data, aes(x = Year, y = Cover, color = Habitat, fill = Habitat)) +
  
  # Shaded error ribbons (Mean +/- 1 SE)
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmax(0, Cover - SE), ymax = Cover + SE), alpha = 0.4, color = NA) +
  
  # Cyclone vertical lines
  geom_vline(xintercept = cyclone_years, linetype = "dashed", color = "indianred", alpha = 0.7) +
  
  # Year text labels at the bottom of the cyclone lines
  #annotate("text", x = cyclone_years, y = -3, label = cyclone_years, 
          # color = "black", size = 3.5, vjust = 1) +
  
  # "Cyclone Event" text in top panels
  geom_text(data = anno_data, aes(label = label), color = "darkred", 
            size = 3, hjust = 0, fontface = "plain") +
  
  # Main data lines and points
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1, color = "black", shape = 21, aes(fill = Habitat), stroke = 0.8) +
  
  # Faceting: scales = "free_x" forces the x-axis to appear on all 4 panels
  facet_wrap(~ Habitat, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") +
  
  # Scales and palettes
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "viridis", guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "viridis", guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1960, 1995, 5), limits = c(1960, 1995)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), limits = c(-5, 100)) +
  
  # Apply minimal theme
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  
  # Custom theme overrides
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    
    # Remove all gridlines
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    # Force X and Y axis lines to stay visible
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    
    # Ensure bottom margins so the new top-row x-axes have breathing room
    panel.spacing.y = unit(2, "lines"), 
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8, margin = margin(r = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 15))
  ) +
  
  # Labels and Caption
  labs(
    x = "Survey Year",
    y = "Coral Cover (%)",
    caption = str_wrap("Figure 2. Percentage cover of corals on four shallow sites from 1962 to 1995, based on Connell et al. (1997). Red vertical dashed lines indicate the years of major cyclone events. Data points are connected by lines and standard error confidence bands.", width = 110)
  )
  ggsave("my_coral_plot.png", width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```
```{r}

ggplot(coral_data, aes(x = Year, y = Cover, color = Habitat, fill = Habitat)) +
  
  # Red dashed disturbance markers
  geom_vline(xintercept = cyclone_years, linetype = "dashed", color = "indianred", alpha = 0.7) +
  
  # Raw data points and smoothed trendlines
  geom_point(size = 1, color = "black", shape = 21, stroke = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, span = 0.5, alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 1) +
  
  # ADDED: scales = "free_x" forces the x-axis to appear on all 4 panels
  facet_wrap(~ Habitat, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") +
  
  # Scales and palettes
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "viridis", guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "viridis", guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1960, 1995, 5), limits = c(1960, 1995)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), limits = c(-5, 100)) +
  
  # Apply minimal theme
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  
  # Custom theme overrides
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    
    # Remove all gridlines
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    # Force X and Y axis lines to stay visible
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    
    # Ensure bottom margins so the new top-row x-axes have breathing room
    panel.spacing.y = unit(2, "lines"), 
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8, margin = margin(r = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 15))
  ) +
  
  # Labels and Caption
  labs(
    x = "Survey Year",
    y = "Coral Cover (%)",
    caption = str_wrap("Figure 2. Percentage cover of corals on four shallow sites from 1962 to 1995, based on Connell et al. (1997). Red vertical dashed lines indicate the years of major cyclone events. Data points are overlaid with a loess smoothing curve and standard error confidence bands.", width = 130)
  )
```

```{r}

#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6

library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)

# 1. Wrangle Data & Add Simulated SE
coral_data <- bind_rows(inner_flat, exposed_pools, protected_crest, exposed_crest) %>%
  mutate(
    Habitat = factor(Habitat, levels = c("Inner Flat", "Exposed Pools", 
                                         "Protected Crest", "Exposed Crest")),
    # Simulating Standard Error (SE) for the shaded ribbon effect
    SE = ifelse(Cover < 10, runif(n(), 1, 3), Cover * runif(n(), 0.1, 0.2)) 
  )

# Define disturbance years
cyclone_years <- c(1967, 1971, 1978, 1980, 1990)

# Dataframe for the year labels at the bottom of the cyclone lines
cyclone_labels <- data.frame(
  Year = cyclone_years,
  Cover = -3,
  label = as.character(cyclone_years)
)

# 2. Build the Single Unified Graph
ggplot(coral_data, aes(x = Year, y = Cover, color = Habitat, fill = Habitat)) +
  
  # Shaded error ribbons (Mean +/- 1 SE)
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmax(0, Cover - SE), ymax = Cover + SE), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  
  # Cyclone vertical lines
  geom_vline(xintercept = cyclone_years, linetype = "dashed", color = "indianred", alpha = 0.6) +
  
  # Year text labels at the bottom of the cyclone lines
  geom_text(data = cyclone_labels, aes(x = Year, y = Cover, label = label), 
            color = "black", size = 3, vjust = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  # Main data lines and points
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8, color = "black", shape = 21, aes(fill = Habitat), stroke = 0.6) +
  
  # NOTE: facet_wrap() is removed so all 4 lines plot on a single graph!
  
  # Scales and palettes (legend is now enabled so you can distinguish habitats)
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "viridis") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "viridis") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1960, 1995, 5), limits = c(1960, 1995)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), limits = c(-5, 100)) +
  
  # Apply minimal theme
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  
  # Custom theme overrides
  theme(
    # Remove gridlines
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    # Force X and Y axis lines to stay visible
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    
    # Axis titles and text styling
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
    
    # Legend placement
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 15, b = 15, l = 10),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8.5, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 15))
  ) +
  
  # Labels and Caption
  labs(
    x = "Survey Year",
    y = "Coral Cover (%)",
    color = "Habitat",
    fill = "Habitat",
    caption = str_wrap("Figure 2. Percentage cover of corals (mean ± 1 SE) across all four shallow reef habitats from 1962 to 1995, based on Connell et al. (1997). Red dashed vertical lines indicate major cyclone events.", width = 110)
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-align: "center" 

library(tidyverse)

# Define a high-contrast, colorblind-friendly manual color palette
habitat_colors <- c(
  "Inner Flat"      = "#0072B2", # Strong Blue
  "Exposed Pools"   = "#009E73", # Bluish Green
  "Protected Crest" = "#D55E00", # Vermilion (Deep Orange-Red)
  "Exposed Crest"   = "#CC79A7"  # Deep Reddish Purple
)

# 1. Wrangle Data & Add Simulated SE
coral_data <- bind_rows(inner_flat, exposed_pools, protected_crest, exposed_crest) %>%
  mutate(
    Habitat = factor(Habitat, levels = c("Inner Flat", "Exposed Pools", 
                                         "Protected Crest", "Exposed Crest")),
    # Simulating Standard Error (SE) for the shaded ribbon effect
    SE = ifelse(Cover < 10, runif(n(), 1, 3), Cover * runif(n(), 0.1, 0.2)) 
  )

# Define disturbance years
cyclone_years <- c(1967, 1971, 1978, 1980, 1990)

# Dataframe for "Cyclone Event" text in top panels
anno_data <- data.frame(
  Habitat = factor(c("Inner Flat", "Exposed Pools"), levels = levels(coral_data$Habitat)),
  Year = 1964, 
  Cover = 99, 
  label = "*Cyclone Event"
)

# Dataframe to bypass the annotate() facet bug for the year labels
cyclone_labels <- data.frame(
  Year = cyclone_years,
  Cover = 97,
  label = as.character(cyclone_years)
)

# 2. Build the Plot with High-Contrast Manual Colors
ggplot(coral_data, aes(x = Year, y = Cover, color = Habitat, fill = Habitat)) +
  
  # Shaded error ribbons (Mean +/- 1 SE)
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmax(0, Cover - SE), ymax = Cover + SE), alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
  
  # Cyclone vertical lines
  geom_vline(xintercept = cyclone_years, linetype = "dashed", color = "indianred", alpha = 0.7) +
  
  # Year text labels at the bottom of the cyclone lines
  #geom_text(data = cyclone_labels, aes(x = Year, y = Cover, label = label), 
            #color = "black", size = 2, vjust = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  # "Cyclone Event" text in top panels
  geom_text(data = anno_data, aes(label = label), color = "darkred", 
            size = 2, hjust = 0, fontface = "plain") +
  
  # Main data lines and points
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.0, color = "black", shape = 21, aes(fill = Habitat), stroke = 0.6) +
  
  # Faceting: 2 columns, forced x-axes on all panels
  facet_wrap(~ Habitat, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") +
  
  # Use manual high-contrast colors instead of viridis
  scale_color_manual(values = habitat_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = habitat_colors, guide = "none") +
  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1960, 1995, 5), limits = c(1960, 1995)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), limits = c(-5, 100)) +
  
  # Apply minimal theme
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  
  # Custom theme overrides for portrait layout and smaller text
  theme(
    # Make individual panels elongated / portrait rectangles
    aspect.ratio = 0.6, 
    
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    
    # Remove all gridlines
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    # Force X and Y axis lines to stay visible
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    
    # Smaller axis text and titles
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 8)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    
    # Panel spacing and margins
    panel.spacing.y = unit(1.0, "lines"), 
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1.0, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 15))
  ) +
  
  # Labels and Caption
  labs(
    x = "Survey Year",
    y = "Coral Cover (%)",
    caption = str_wrap("Figure 2. Percentage cover of corals (mean ± 1 SE) on four shallow sites from 1962 to 1995, based on Connell et al. (1997). *Red vertical dashed lines indicate the years of major cyclone events. Shaded bands represent standard error confidence intervals.", width = 100)
  )
```
